text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Monster Bird soars! A miraculous grand flight—!!
She catches Silence Suzuka, and—!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Siiiiiiiiiiiiiik!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: I will not collapse today! As a magnificent champion, I shall strike a pose of victory before a packed crowd of fans!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer! El... El did iiiiiit!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that Mainichi Okan,
Trainer and Grass have been encouraging me...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I've finally made it this far!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno!
Thank you very much-desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just one race, I managed to beat
the fastest champion, Suzuka-senpai,
also known as the 'Runaway Mach Warrior'!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Nobody called me, though...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Suzuka-senpai!
Um... I'm really sorry-desu!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's fine.
Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I think you understand now.
You possess a strength that is entirely your own."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Because I can turn the cheers of others into my strength.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: See ya.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? People... cheering...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan...! El-chan is!
Suzuka-san is! El-chan is~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Which one?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Both of them~!
El-chan won!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Indeed. They beat us to it. But at the same time, as a representative of our generation, they did us proud...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Still, this is not the end.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The time to watch over El has ended. That is what it means.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone at Hanshin Racecourse!
Pay attention, behold, and praise me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And the name of today's winner is—?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno-!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And this victory is merely
a stepping stone on our journey, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Guided by Suzuka-senpai, where will the Condor
head in her quest for the title of world's strongest!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's the grand stage I once had to give up on!
The Japan Cup, where the world's strongest gather!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And who is the Umamusume
destined to be the victor there—!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That is correct!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sorry to keep you waiting!
El is finally, finally, finally
all ready, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let us go this time.
To the Japan Cup!

And so, after a whole year,
El Condor Pasa was finally able to get back on track.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Still, there is something I do not quite understand, desu..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-senpai said it before.
'El grows stronger when fueled by the crowd's cheers.'"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Every Umamusume should feel that way, though...
Even if Suzuka-senpai is different, take Spe-chan, for instance.”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why would Suzuka-senpai say
it was all thanks to El's power...?

I can't say for sure. But there must be
a reason why El Condor Pasa was able to win today.
